page.overview:
Who is Beer Vendor?

The Beer Vendor is a man who sells bottles of Duff Beer. After Homer Simpson watched "Pukahontas" in the Aztec Theater, he pledged to never drink alcohol again. However, when the Beer Vendor randomly walked by, he bought a beer.
